question: How rare are the knowers of truth of the upper tradition, and who is addressed?
premises: The verse speaks of knowers of truth belonging to the upper tradition.
Such knowers are characterized as rare.
The addressee is the hero-praised lady.
inference: The verse declares rare the truth-knowers of the upper tradition, addressing the hero-praised lady.
uncertainties: Whether vīravandite addresses Pārvatī specifically is contextual (Kula dialogue frame) rather than stated in the verse.
The byte-pinned e-text reads singular feminine throughout; the legacy working gloss read plurals and is not followed.
plain_english: O lady praised by heroes — rare is the knower of truth of the upper tradition.
